thesis: The site is the garage door itself: each section is a panel that rises as you scroll, revealing the ordered space behind the clutter, and the village name on the handle tells you this is your street.

signature.name: garage-door panels
signature.summary: Sectional garage-door panels with horizontal rules and village labels rise via clip-path on scroll; reviews hang on inside faces; footer is door fully up. Hook: data-sw-signature='garage-panel'.

motion.intro: Hero door rises one panel; headline fades in lit gap (≤1.2s).
stories: Six village garages open one per scroll step
Keep-pile items sort into destination columns
motion.hover: Hairline grows from left via scaleX on interactive elements.
